profile.headline: Software Developer at Sentel Inc
profile.summary: Would reconsider for stable permanent position.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained computer-based tools utilized by the IRS (Internal Revenue Service) Tax Auditors, Revenue Agents, Tax Examiners, Appeals Staff, Customer Service Representatives, and other functional support personnel.
Maintained, developed and converted the Report Generation Software (RGS) program which was majority written in VB6 to C# and .NET framework - The RGS program still continues its supporting, adds new features while many ActiveX Control (ocx, dll) and COM are re-architected to C#/.NET.
Maintained software and versions controlled under ClearQuest and ClearCase.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and Developed the User Interface (GUI) for programs used for whole house design, combines the power of current company's legacy products. 
Developed and distributed COM via from various templates from legacy program which is primarily written in VB6 and FORTRAN 
Designed and developed a new application which combined two applications in different platforms: The one was original in C for Windows 3.1 and Win32 application. The new application which utilizes the MFC and the Parametric Design Engine which help designer to modify the plans by simply changing its dimensions on layout. 
Designed Software Modules utilizing OOD (Object-Oriented Design) and Design Patterns, ATL, STL with C++ for program developed under Visual Studio .NET (Visual C++). Converted current codes in Win32 API SDK to MFC.
Wrote various functions using OpenGL to display the house plan design in 3D-Realtime view.
Developed Stored Procedures, ADO functions, interfacing with Firebird relational database for storing and reporting lumber materials on each order. Analyzed and debugged databases with FlameRobin and IBExpert utilities.
Wrote various functions in MFC via Multi-threading, print-review and printer control, ActiveX and import/export DLL functions and libraries.
Converted several functions from C, FORTRAN and VB for Win32 to C++/MFC
Conducted Software testing and debugging: unit, module, peer-view test.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed wireless applications for Concurrent Services Project -- The Concurrent Services feature allows subscribers to have simultaneous circuit voice and packet data sessions on mobiles that support this feature and are provisioned and enabled for concurrent services in their subscriber profile.
Developed software and led the software engineer team for the project to convert the legacy Line-Trunk-Manager programs to port to new hardware (PowerPC) and real-time operating system (Lynx OS). Object Oriented Designed (OOD) with UML from Rational Rose RT tool and Developed with Lynx Real-time UNIX C++.
Migrated wireless source code controlled by ClearCase from Alcatel's SDE to Motorola's Shared Network.
Performed codes converted many legacy programs written in assembly to C language for the ease of maintenance and enhancement.
Performed PL/SQL analysis, administration and wrote/debugged store procedure, trigger for Oracle8i database. Developed database application with C and used Oracle OCI (Oracle Call Interface),

positions.title: Information System Specialist
positions.description:
Supported, developed and maintained Excel's CTI systems environment based from IVR, ACD and middleware from Edify, Vantive and Cisco's ICM.
Supported HP's CCM Computer Telephony Integration system at Excel. This included developing new programs that controlled the delivery of telephone calls to a customer service agent's desktop and delivering account information to the agent when the telephone rings. Client software development was done using Visual C++/MFC and Win32 for Windows/NT platform. Server software was developed on UNIX platform -- The HP-6000 system, using C programming with embedded Sybase SQL queries.
Developed new CTI application with pop-up screen and soft phone to support desk top agent.  The new client software codes are based on middleware and CTI drivers and libraries from Siebel CTI (v6) and Cisco-Geotel's ICM (v4.6). The Visual C++ was used as main coding. The Object Oriented Design is based from MFC. The ActiveX, Socket, TCP/IP and ODBC are implemented by all the applications.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sustained and developed embedded Call Processing and MMI programs written in Assembler language and C for Z8000 processor.
Developed automated test programs written in C++, test plans for embedded and device drivers programs coded in C, for running under Lynx OS.
Wrote technical documents, software design, software installation & configuration, new software release and packaging, written in Java, Perl (use package) and Shell script.
Designed, Developed and maintained C++ Telecom platform tools and Datacom tools via TCP/UDP, ethernet, UART, libraries, device drivers and programs for multi-platform such as Solaris UNIX, LynxOS and Windows.

positions.title: Software Manager, Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed small group of software engineers responsible for design and development PC based applications.
Designed and developed the ATM's gateway application and embedded program to control and handle the phone line connection when there is a transaction on Deibold ATM. All transactions are stored in PC file instead of on paper, by using fake ATM's internal printer.
Developed Class 5 telephony (switches) PC based products which used Dialogic cards for IVR and ACD. The applications are coded with Borland C/C++, MS/Visual C/C++ for Win32 applications.
Designed and developed Class 5 telephony (switches) -- call processing controlled applications used by hotel, air port and prison. The software controls Call Duration, Debit Call, and Collect Call with auto voice menu driven, Forbidden Call list, Spy Call, Call Routing and generates instant Call Billing, Call Detail Record report.
Designed and developed online credit card processing and validation server.
Developed Database Storage Management, Query and Report applications coded in C and used Novell Btrieve and SQL
Developed multiple platforms software libraries for Telecom and Datacom, device drivers via UART and tools for serial communications applications. Borland C/C++ and Visual C++ compilers were used as main software coding. The programs have an average of half million lines of C++ code.
Maintained and performed integration tests on embedded programs, written in Zilog 8 assembly and C language, loaded onto EPROM.
Prepared test plans and data, and user documentation for customer billing system.
